## Why This Benchmark Is Included

Canonical historical MLPerf reinforcement-learning workload.

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Classroom value** | Demonstrates self-play, search, dynamic data generation, and evaluation. |
| **Systems behavior** | Repeated inference in tree search coupled to iterative training. |
| **Benchmark lineage** | Direct MLPerf Training lineage. |
| **Model choice** | MiniGo is the MLPerf-selected RL reference. |
| **Dataset choice** | Self-play is intrinsic to the canonical task. |
| **Quality metric** | The original workload fixes professional-move prediction and a 100-game promotion playoff. |
| **Published baseline** | Original MLPerf Training v0.5 MiniGo reference workload |
| **Alternative rejected** | CartPole and Pendulum are substitutions without MLPerf lineage. |

## Current Preflight and Handoff

::: {.callout-warning}
**The quality path is not a general local run yet.** Supply a reviewed immutable CUDA/TensorFlow 1.x runtime image and execute the resumable pinned MiniGo quality loop on a suitable NVIDIA system.
The `max` and `pro` runners fail closed until the declared assets, hardware, and runtime are available. Use `doctor` to inspect the machine-readable environment handoff.
:::

```bash
# inspect the authoritative environment handoff
uv run mlperf doctor --workload reinforcement-learning --profile max --format json

# preview asset requirements without downloading
uv run mlperf fetch --workload reinforcement-learning --profile max --dry-run

# the bounded functional path runs on supported local hardware
uv run mlperf run --workload reinforcement-learning --profile min
```

A successful `min` result verifies the local plumbing only. It does not evaluate the authoritative quality target. See the [running guide](../../guide/running.qmd) for the current local-execution boundary and recovery status.
